included: one potable-water service connection from an existing pressurized distribution main
buried service pipe, trench layers, warning tape and tracer wire
sealed and insulated building penetration through an existing prepared wall opening
pressure testing, flushing, disinfection, sampling, records, labor, equipment and logistics
excluded: internal building water distribution beyond the meter assembly
invented road restoration, groundwater lowering, trench support or external meter chamber

authority.kind: transparent preliminary scenario, not an approved original and not a universal norm
confirmationRequiredFrom: approved water-service connection drawing and utility connection conditions
existing-main survey and operator-approved tapping method
pipe, tapping, valve, meter and penetration-system manufacturers
approved method statement and pressure-test/disinfection program
authority.pricePolicy: No admitted price source is supplied. All unit prices remain NULL while calculated rows remain visible.

questionPolicy.ordinaryRoute: Ask only the selected connection count, measured route, selected service-pipe system and the existing-main material/diameter needed to select the tapping assembly.
automatic: trench, bedding, surround, placed backfill, imported backfill and excess soil volumes
installed pipe, expected loss, retained spare, stock, package count, ordered length and remainder
straight pipe joints and their fusion consumables
one complete tapping, isolation, building-entry and meter assembly per connection
warning tape, tracer wire, flushing water, disinfectant, test consumables
labor, machine time, transport and records from calculated quantities and visible unit norms
conditionalProjectFacts: groundwater dewatering system and machine-hours when required
road/pavement restoration system and measured area when required
external meter chamber type when the approved layout requires it
trench-wall support system and supported length when required

formulaNotes.trench: route length × trench bottom width × trench depth
formulaNotes.bedding: route length × trench bottom width × bedding thickness
formulaNotes.surround: gross surround prism minus external pipe displacement
formulaNotes.placedBackfill: trench minus bedding prism minus gross surround prism
formulaNotes.importedBackfill: positive deficit after reuse of suitable excavated soil
formulaNotes.excessSoil: excavated soil not reused in placed backfill
formulaNotes.pipeOrder: ceil(max(0, installed + loss + retained spare - stock) / package length) × package length
formulaNotes.installedJoints: max(0, ceil(installed route / installed piece length) - connection count); supplier package does not change installed topology
formulaNotes.disinfectant: flushing water × dose, converted from mg/L to kg active substance, divided by confirmed active fraction

acceptanceObligations: ordinary route compiles without asking for final quantities
changing route length or trench depth recalculates dependent quantities
changing supplier package or available stock recalculates purchase but not installed joints
all materials and consumables needed for the bounded connection are visible even when price is NULL
conditional branches remain absent until explicitly required
